doc: One castle part to build (design/planner.md, Castles): the part, the lot size it stands on, and the season.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its lot: small (rect6x5), medium (rect8x6), large (rect10x7), or keep (rect8x8).

fields.name: theme
fields.doc: The village theme: its architecture and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: How far it has come: planning (its lot staked out, materials piled), half (walls half up in scaffolding), finished, or a ruin.
